rows: The first draft was prepared by the Maintenance Procedures Development and Quality Control Sector of the Holding Company and was reviewed and approved by the MPIS coordinators at the meetings of 31 July 2007 and 11 September 2007, for the purpose of quality control of steam turbine maintenance at the electricity generation companies
All readings are compared with the design or permissible value
Steam temperature at the turbine inlet
Curtis wheel pressure "steam pressure in the first stage of the turbine"
Pressure and temperature of the reheated steam — Reheat Steam
Steam temperature at the turbine outlet "ensuring there is no moisture in the steam"
Pressure and temperature of the oil returning from the turbine shaft bearings
Shaft axial displacement — Shaft Axial Displacement
Slow turning system for cooling the turbine shaft — Shaft Turning Gear "operates after the unit is taken out of service"
Steam High Pressure & Low Pressure Bypass operating circuit:
- Control oil circuit for valve operation

Results of steam sample analysis: - At the inlet of the high pressure turbine (HPT) - At the intermediate pressure turbine (IPT) (from the Hot Reheat outlet); the conductivity value is noted, in micromho/cm
- Turbine start-up curve from standstill until reaching normal speed
- Turbine shutdown curve from normal speed to standstill
- Turbine gradual loading and load reduction curves
Internal washing of the turbine: as per the manufacturer's instructions - at 25% of its normal speed - while under maintenance
Procedure to prevent air entering the turbine "while the unit is on standby" to prevent chemical corrosion, as per the manufacturer's instructions
- Air inlet and outlet filters of the main oil tank — Breather
- Vapour extraction fan of the unit oil tank
- Oil leakages from the oil circuits
- Condition of the electric heaters of the oil tank
- Rate of topping up the oil tank
Reports of maintenance, major overhauls and replacement and renewal:
- Reports of rotor alignment measurement for the turbine and generator — Alignment
- Reports of calibration of the turbine load control system
- Main steam valves on the turbine: Combination valves, Main Stop valves, Control valves, Reheat valves
Test and inspection reports to verify their sound operation
- Clearance measurements for the fixed and moving blades of the turbine stages
- Closed and open balancing reports for the turbine shaft
- Maintenance reports carried out on the unit as per MPIS documents: (periodic, preventive, predictive, major overhauls, replacement and renewal)
- Record of rehabilitation of parts replaced with new ones
